name: Disable IPv6
description: Disables IPv6 stack on the system to reduce unnecessary processing
warnings: May break Xbox and Microsoft store apps
revert22H2:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\TCPIP6\Parameters" /v DisabledComponents /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
netsh int ipv6 set state enabled
revert23H2:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\TCPIP6\Parameters" /v DisabledComponents /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
netsh int ipv6 set state enabled
revert24H2:

revertCommands:
